subject: Mutual Action Plan: draft & timeline options — Acme Health
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 16:20:00 -0500
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: draft & timeline options — Acme Health

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the time today. Good conversation and a clear sense of the goals: reduce inference latency for clinical triage workflows and get predictable inference costs for production. Per our ask, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that reflects the items we discussed during the discovery call. High level:

- Outcome: pilot Redwood inference running in your dev VPC with SOC2 evidence collection and an integration path to your workflow in scope.
- Proposed target close (two timeline options below).
- Milestones: pilot kickoff, SOC2 evidence review, procurement/order form, pilot validation, production rollout.

Two timeline options (pick what best matches your org appetite):

Option A — Fast track (6 weeks)
- Week 0: MAP kickoff and finalize stakeholders
- Week 1–2: infra access + architecture review
- Week 3: pilot deploy + smoke tests
- Week 4: SOC2 evidence exchange
- Week 5–6: pilot validation & order form

Option B — Procurement-first (12 weeks) — recommended if you need formal procurement and security review (SOC2):
- Week 0–2: MAP kickoff, procurement & legal kickoff
- Week 3–6: SOC2 evidence & security review + required artifacts
- Week 7–9: pilot deploy + validation
- Week 10–12: finalize order form / SOW & production schedule

Ask: can you confirm the internal stakeholders we should include on the MAP (owners for procurement, security, and product)? I’ve tentatively cc'd Aditya from my side as the escalation/contract owner.

Attached: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (initial draft) — it includes milestone dates and suggested owners we can adjust. I also uploaded a copy to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-ACME-MAP

Suggested next step: 30-minute MAP kickoff to agree owners and pick a timeline option. I’m available Tue/Wed next week — proposed slot: Tue 2026-02-16 11:00 AM ET. If that doesn’t work, share a few windows and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear recap and the MAP draft.

Stakeholders from our side (please include these on the MAP):
- Julia Ramos (Product) — me, primary decision owner
- Chris Lee (IT Security) — will own SOC2 evidence & technical review
- Maria Gomez (Procurement) — will own contract/order form and procurement timeline
- Legal (copied) — will handle redlines

Given our internal cadence, we’ll need to run a SOC2 evidence review before committing to a contract. That pushes us toward Option B (procurement-first). Tentative target close: 2026-04-02 (we have a budget cycle the first week of April).

Requests:
1) Can you share a concise SOC2 artifact checklist and the architecture diagram you referenced during the call?
2) An initial procurement estimate (ballpark MRR or committed capacity) to show to Maria and legal would be helpful.

We can do the MAP kickoff on Tue 2026-02-16 11:00 AM ET (that works for me). If you could include the draft with owners filled in (including your internal owners), that’ll speed the kickoff.

Julia
Julia Ramos
Head of Product, Clinical Workflows — Acme Health
